title: Best Sahara Desert Tour – Which One to Choose?
description: Compare Sahara tours in Morocco: 2-day, 3-day, luxury camps, camel treks. Find the perfect desert experience for you.
content:
## The Classic 3-Day Tour

The most popular option. Depart from Marrakech, cross the Atlas, visit Aït Benhaddou, and reach Merzouga for a camel ride and night in a luxury camp.

## 2-Day Express

Short on time? A 2-day tour from Fes still gives you a sunset camel trek and night under the stars.

## Luxury Camp Experience

Private tents with en-suite bathrooms, gourmet meals, and 4x4 transfers. Perfect for honeymoons.

## What to Pack

- Lightweight scarf for sand
- Warm layer for cold desert nights
- Sunscreen and sunglasses
